ledger.gap: Where two consecutive releases lie on the same day, the diff isolates revision drift. A night-to-morning diff mixes drift with the league's filing deadline, which is why the same-day pair is the one to read.

diff.note: The earlier session's 09:15 AM transcription vs this session's read of the 09:30 AM PDF. A row that appears here is either a real revision in those 15 minutes or a transcription error in the earlier capture; both rows are linked to a PDF so the reader can settle it. This is a provenance check, not a claim about the league.

policy.revision_time: the time printed in the release's own header
policy.index_checked: when the official index was last checked for a newer release
policy.rows: every cell is assigned by content type, never by position; a cell whose type cannot be determined is left blank and flagged
policy.hash: sha256 over the stored rendering text, so an edit is detectable
policy.bytes: the PDF bytes are archived by nba2/v4/injury_ingest.py, not by this build
